turns.reply: Kondapur ನಮ್ಮ service area ಒಳಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ same-day visits guarantee ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಾವು next-day slots ಮಾತ್ರ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ 10 AM ಇಂದ ಸಂಜೆ 6 PM ವರೆಗೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ visit book ಮಾಡಲು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?

issues.quote: Kondapur ನಮ್ಮ service area ಒಳಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ
issues.fix: Use Indian English, e.g. “Yes, Kondapur is in our service area.”
Say it in Indian English: “We have next-day slots between 10 AM and 6 PM.”

issues.quote: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ 10 AM ಇಂದ ಸಂಜೆ 6 PM ವರೆಗೆ
issues.fix: Since this is an Indic sentence with clock times, avoid this format; in the required Indian English reply, say “between 10 AM and 6 PM.”
The caller asked for tomorrow morning, not same-day. Better: “Tomorrow can be requested, but the team will confirm the exact slot.”

judge.verdict_note: The reply is mostly factually aligned and tries to collect booking details, but it is in Kannada instead of the configured Indian English, and it answers with an unnecessary same-day caveat rather than directly addressing tomorrow morning.

Caller 'tomorrow morning' అన్నాడు కాబట్టి ముందుగా morning requestని acknowledge చేసి, 'రేపు morning slot కోసం note చేస్తాను; మీ పేరు చెప్పండి' లాగా details అడగాలి.

judge.verdict_note: Reply is mostly natural Telugu-English code-mix and factually correct. Main issues: clock times written in AM/PM inside Telugu are TTS-unfriendly, and it could respond more directly to the requested tomorrow morning visit before asking for time.
